_comment: Blocks an Age's rock may be made of though the shape rule refuses them -- the exception channel, for
where `Materials`' one question is wrong about a particular block.
Cake is what it was made for: seven sixteenths high, so not a full cube and refused by the rule, and
a world of it is exactly the sort of thing the Art should be able to say (Jonah).
A block named here skips every part of the rule including the block-entity refusal, which is a real
way to make a world that cannot be loaded -- a world of chests is one block entity per block. It is
left possible on purpose: writing a block into this file is as deliberate as an author gets.
